native_window_depth.logic: Read dates beside article headlines; retain early morning; selected source page2 at most once, only until cutoff; no unbounded search.

realistic_search_gate.denominator: 14 configured source routes + 6 shared WEB queries
realistic_search_gate.target: at least 18/20 successfully parsed search tasks
realistic_search_gate.editorial_recall_claim: UNMEASURED; NEVER CONFLATE WITH 90 PERCENT ARTICLES

other_issues_unmodified.topic: Morning/previous afternoon full-window coverage still unproven
other_issues_unmodified.evidence: Small probe found earliest listing time 09:58 on medipana and 09:19 on newsthevoice despite 2-page attempt, with source statuses PARTIAL.
other_issues_unmodified.cause: Page listings/sections do not consistently carry yesterday-noon articles; daypart-balanced candidates cannot replace a past checkpoint.
other_issues_unmodified.proposal: Retain 06:05 morning snapshot and compare with later incremental changes; only add a narrow historical scan for sources with demonstrated gaps. Do not perform unconditional multi-page crawls.
other_issues_unmodified.tradeoff: Checkpoint retention/storage changes needed; later delta run optional and may add requests.

other_issues_unmodified.topic: Scheduled collection writes artifacts, not persistent GitHub staging
other_issues_unmodified.evidence: Collection workflow has contents:read and upload-artifact retention-days 14. It does not commit source staging JSON to main.
other_issues_unmodified.cause: No automatic persistent checkpoint publishing path in workflow.
other_issues_unmodified.proposal: Store a validated, nonpublic staging checkpoint after each collection with immutable run ID and safe overwrite/concurrency; keep Pages/data promotion disabled.
other_issues_unmodified.tradeoff: Requires carefully scoped workflow write permission and concurrency test before enabling.

other_issues_unmodified.topic: Measured article recall has no valid independent denominator
other_issues_unmodified.evidence: Third Oct12 benchmark only matched 8 of 26 previously reviewed examples by exact URL/normalized headline; these are historical and not independent ground truth.
other_issues_unmodified.cause: Google index and observed native listing reflect discovery, not the total relevant published-article universe.
other_issues_unmodified.proposal: Use a small, date-matched, independently reviewed priority-event sample; report measured recall and omissions separately from 20/20 route success.
other_issues_unmodified.tradeoff: Light editorial sampling required for initial calibration, not 23 exhaustive crawls.

other_issues_unmodified.topic: Original verification has very low ratio in high-volume discovery
other_issues_unmodified.evidence: Third live collection produced 334 discovery candidates but only 12 verified originals in the stage4 output at that time.
other_issues_unmodified.cause: Verification budget 12, RSS aggregator token redirects, and a shared queue of noisy headlines.
other_issues_unmodified.proposal: Dedup by original-article URL first; verify P0/P1 publishers directly when available, reuse existing verification cache, record unresolved RSS tokens explicitly.
other_issues_unmodified.tradeoff: May shift the fixed 12-verification budget toward priority items, without increasing budget.

other_issues_unmodified.topic: 40-item review queue can hide useful priority items
other_issues_unmodified.evidence: Stage4 limits output to 40 after sorting; all raw discoveries remain in separate evidence but may not be visible to editors.
other_issues_unmodified.cause: Hard cap optimizes review workload but is not an editorial recall guarantee.
other_issues_unmodified.proposal: Give P0 and strong P1 items a protected queue and show count/examples of overflow; calibrate threshold against observed misses.
other_issues_unmodified.tradeoff: Occasional larger displayed priority queue, but not more search requests.

other_issues_unmodified.topic: Stage4 output has unenriched previews while strict final validator requires structured quick/diff previews
other_issues_unmodified.evidence: Stage4 falls back to article_preview={} and summary='', whereas validate_briefing.py requires populated quick/diff previews.
other_issues_unmodified.cause: Discovery candidate schema is intentionally not publication-ready.
other_issues_unmodified.proposal: Add narrow editorial enrichment only for selected verified items after the 40-item review queue; do not fabricate summaries from RSS titles.
other_issues_unmodified.tradeoff: Additional language-model processing on selected items; separate approval needed.

other_issues_unmodified.evidence: No global, patent or schedule collector changes were made in these two domestic fixes.
other_issues_unmodified.proposal: Do not resume until domestic checkpoint and core news discovery are stable.

notes: All statuses use strict evidence; native text dates are index evidence only, original publisher timestamps needed for article finalization.
GitHub CI is offline only on code pushes; mini probe accessed only three domestic sources.
Do not create automatic Pages/Telegram release or expand into global/patent.
